taxonomic_scope: 20 arthropod orders and 2 composite target groups
policy_note: At least 100 sequences per target group and 10000 total; each successful monthly build retains prior accession versions and bytes and adds at least 1 percent. General COI scoring uses every retained template with explicit partial or legacy provenance; clustering is reserved for preview displays.
BeePrime retains its publication-specific Gurten evidence alongside the general full-order panel.
